components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The main call-to-action. Manuscript ink background, script paper text, pill radius.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { cursor: pointer; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; padding: 8px 20px; font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; color: oklch(0.97 0.004 51); background: oklch(0.155 0.014 51); border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 9999px; transition: background 150ms ease; text-decoration: none; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: oklch(0.22 0.014 51); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.58 0.1 239); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { cursor: not-allowed; opacity: 0.6; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Bordered utility button for secondary actions. Transparent with border.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { cursor: pointer; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; padding: 8px 20px; font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; color: oklch(0.155 0.014 51); background: oklch(0.985 0.004 51); border: 1px solid oklch(0.875 0.014 51); border-radius: 9999px; transition: background 150ms ease, border-color 150ms ease; text-decoration: none; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: oklch(0.952 0.004 51); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.58 0.1 239); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-secondary:disabled { cursor: not-allowed; opacity: 0.6; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Lowest visual weight. Toolbar actions, icon buttons, secondary nav items.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { cursor: pointer; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; padding: 8px 20px; font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; color: oklch(0.465 0.014 51); background: transparent; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 9999px; transition: background 150ms ease, color 150ms ease; text-decoration: none; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { color: oklch(0.155 0.014 51); background: oklch(0.952 0.004 51); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.58 0.1 239); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-ghost:disabled { cursor: not-allowed; opacity: 0.6; }

components.name: Danger Button
components.description: Destructive actions. Transparent with red text and partial red border.
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { cursor: pointer; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; padding: 8px 20px; font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; color: oklch(0.54 0.127 14.8); background: transparent; border: 1px solid color-mix(in oklch, oklch(0.54 0.127 14.8) 35%, oklch(0.875 0.014 51)); border-radius: 9999px; transition: background 150ms ease, border-color 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-danger:hover { background: color-mix(in oklch, oklch(0.54 0.127 14.8) 10%, transparent); } .ds-btn-danger:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.54 0.127 14.8); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-danger:disabled { cursor: not-allowed; opacity: 0.6; }

components.name: Card
components.description: Default structural container. Flat at rest; border lifts toward Manuscript on hover.
components.html:
Script title

Act 1 · Scene 3 · 24 pages
components.css: .ds-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 16px; min-height: 160px; padding: 20px; background: oklch(0.985 0.004 51); border: 1px solid oklch(0.875 0.014 51); border-radius: 10px; transition: border-color 150ms ease, box-shadow 150ms ease; cursor: pointer; } .ds-card:hover { border-color: color-mix(in oklch, oklch(0.155 0.014 51) 12%, oklch(0.875 0.014 51)); box-shadow: 0 10px 20px oklch(.177 .006 41.5 / .08); } .ds-card:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.58 0.1 239); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-card-header { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; } .ds-card-title { font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 500; color: oklch(0.155 0.014 51); } .ds-card-body { font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; color: oklch(0.465 0.014 51); line-height: 1.5; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Standard text field. Rounded small, subtle border, focus shifts border to accent tint.
components.css: .ds-input { box-sizing: border-box; width: 100%; padding: 6px 10px; font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; color: oklch(0.155 0.014 51); background: oklch(0.985 0.004 51); border: 1px solid oklch(0.875 0.014 51); border-radius: 6px; transition: border-color 150ms ease; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: oklch(0.465 0.014 51); opacity: 0.6; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: oklch(0.908 0.014 51); outline: none; } .ds-input:disabled { cursor: not-allowed; opacity: 0.4; }

components.name: Tag / Chip
components.description: Structural label using the mono voice. Uppercase, letter-spaced, pill radius.
components.css: .ds-tag { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 2px 8px; font-family: 'Courier Prime', 'Courier New', monospace; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 400; color: oklch(0.465 0.014 51); text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.08em; background: oklch(0.908 0.014 51); border-radius: 9999px; }

components.description: Sticky top navigation bar. Script Paper background, border-bottom divider, ghost icon buttons for tools.

narrative.overview:
The theatre before the house lights come up. Attention belongs to the work on the page, not to the tool holding it. Stagistic's design system exists in the wings: disciplined, unobtrusive, and exactly where it needs to be when the playwright needs it. The interface never interrupts a line of dialogue or a blocking note to announce itself.

The palette begins from a warm near-neutral — manuscript ink, script paper, stage lamp amber — and operates in restraint. The density is app-appropriate: compact, information-rich, never cluttered. In dark mode the whole system reads as the dark stage: near-black warm surfaces, warm near-white text, the amber accent rising like a working light. In light mode, the same warmth reads as a freshly turned page. Both modes share identical structure; only the lightness levels shift.

This system explicitly rejects three things. Heavy SaaS dashboard patterns belong to project management tools, not to a playwright's instrument. Gamified or visually loud apps pull attention from the script; nothing here earns its place through decoration. Loud marketing aesthetics — feature-grid carousels, hero-metric numbers, purple gradients — are forbidden on both app and landing surfaces.
keyCharacteristics: Warm neutrals rooted in a single amber-tinted base; no arbitrary cool gray injection
Two complementary typefaces: IBM Plex Sans Variable for the interface, Courier Prime for scripted labels and the script canvas
Flat surfaces at rest; structural shadows only on floating elements
Full light/dark theme parity — same tokens, same structure, only lightness levels change
A size-scale system that lets users shift the entire UI density without layout reflow
OKLCH throughout, relative-color-syntax for derived tokens — the system never drifts out of hue cohesion

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Working Amber appears on ≤5% of any given screen. It carries meaning: something is in progress, something is selected. Diluting it with decorative use destroys its signal value.

rules.name: The Hue Cohesion Rule
rules.body: All neutrals are derived from --base-neutral via relative-color-syntax. A new surface color is always oklch(from var(--base-neutral) <L> calc(c * <factor>) h). Never introduce an independent gray hex.

rules.name: The Two-Voice Rule
rules.body: Courier Prime is the script's voice; IBM Plex Sans is the tool's voice. They don't overlap. Body copy is always sans. Script-canvas text and structural labels are always mono. Mixing them on the same element is prohibited.

rules.name: The Size-Scale Rule
rules.body: All font sizes, spacing values, and control heights are multiplied by --size-scale. New values must follow this pattern. Never define a fixed-pixel font size that bypasses the scale.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: No element carries a shadow at rest unless it is a floating overlay. If it's in the document flow, it uses tonal layering. If it's floating (popover, modal, drawer), it uses shadow.

dos: Do keep the script canvas as the highest-contrast, most visually prominent element on any editor screen.
Do use the OKLCH relative-color-syntax pattern for all new surface colors.
Do derive all spacing and font sizes through --size-scale.
Do use Courier Prime for any label, marker, or element that belongs to the theatrical script structure.
Do keep Working Amber rare — progress bars and active selection highlights only.
Do apply shadows only to floating elements that break the document flow.
Do support prefers-reduced-motion with zero-duration or fade-only fallbacks.
Do use color-mix(in oklch, ...) for all hover/state color derivations.
donts: Don't introduce heavy SaaS dashboard patterns: dense sidebars, data tables as default, enterprise navigation.
Don't add gamified or colorful elements: badges, reward animations, visual busy-ness that pulls focus from the script.
Don't use loud marketing aesthetics on any surface: gradients, hero-metric numbers, feature-card grids, buzzword copy, eyebrow-on-every-section pattern.
Don't use border-left or border-right greater than 1px as a colored accent stripe.
Don't use background-clip: text with a gradient for decorative text.
Don't mix IBM Plex Sans and Courier Prime on the same text element.
Don't introduce a new gray color that doesn't derive from --base-neutral hue 51°.
Don't use z-index values above 20 in component CSS.
